description: Merge requests (everything not automerged) are opened and updated on Saturdays only, so they come in one weekly batch

packageRules.description: Images this repo does not version: Nextcloud AIO updates itself from its own interface, portfolio-app is built locally by CI
Immich's database and Redis images are chosen by Immich's release compose file: change them only when an Immich release says so
linuxserver.io tags carry the app version plus a -lsNNN build number (and a libtorrent or -rN part for some images)
Plex and SearXNG tags end with a commit hash, which must not be read as a variant of the image
Immich server and machine learning must always run the same version
GitLab Runner should follow the GitLab version; GitLab majors need the documented upgrade path
A Postgres or Valkey major version needs a data migration (dump/restore or pg_upgrade), never a tag bump
The media apps have the same release rhythm: their major updates come in one merge request

Minor, patch and digest updates of the services where a bad release is an inconvenience: one branch, pushed to main without a merge request once its pipeline passes, between 02:00 and 06:00, never on Sunday (the weekly backup stops and restarts the stacks from 03:00). A failed pipeline opens a merge request instead. A release waits 3 days when its registry gives a date; lscr.io, ghcr.io and most others give none, and requiring one would hold their updates forever
The same updates of the services where a bad release loses data, access or the network: one weekly merge request, merged by hand (Immich and GitLab keep their own groups)
